name: GitHub
description: Read repositories, issues and pull requests.
scopes: Fine-grained token: selected repositories, Metadata, Issues and Pull requests — read only.

name: GitLab
description: Browse projects, issues and merge requests.
scopes: Personal access token with read_api. GitLab.com or a public HTTPS GitLab host.

name: Bitbucket
description: Read Bitbucket Cloud repositories and pull requests.
scopes: Scoped API token: read:user:bitbucket, read:workspace:bitbucket, read:repository:bitbucket and read:pullrequest:bitbucket. Use your Atlassian email, not an app password. Discovery checks up to 10 workspaces.

name: Azure DevOps
description: Browse projects, repositories and pull requests.
scopes: Personal access token scoped to your organization: Project and Team read, Code read.

name: Gitea
description: Read repositories, issues and pull requests on Gitea.
scopes: Personal token: read:user and read:repository. Gitea.com or a public HTTPS Gitea host.

name: Linear
scopes: Personal API key with read access to the teams you select.

name: Jira
description: Browse Jira Cloud projects and their issues.
scopes: Atlassian email and Jira Cloud API token. Your account needs Browse projects. Scoped tokens use your Cloud ID.
